<b>1. Utrustning</b> – lägg till din utr: 1. Equipment – add your equipment (mixer, DSP, amplifiers …) and draw arrows between them. An arrow means something is started before the next thing and turned off after it.
<b>2. Regler</b> (under Utrustning) – fi: 2. Rules (under Equipment) – fine-tune order, priority ("always first"), delays and conditions such as "wait until the amplifier reports on".
<b>3. Grupper</b> – skapa t.ex. ett rum: 3. Groups – e.g. one group per room, and choose the equipment the room needs. Shared equipment (e.g. a common mixer) starts with the first group and is only turned off when the last group turns off.
<b>4. Sekvenser</b> – varje grupp får en: 4. Sequences – every group gets a sequence automatically. Adjust it by hand if you like, or create your own sequences without groups.
<b>5. Fjärrkontroller</b> – koppla knapp: 5. Remotes – link buttons directly to groups and sequences, no automations needed.
Håll muspekaren över en grupp för att se: Hover over a group to see which equipment it uses. The coloured dots show which groups share a unit.
